_comment: Proposed by the ConnectShare route agent (2026-10-15) for the orchestrator to merge into migration/parity-exemptions.json. The first two rules and the call-order entry are capture/timing artifacts (auto-accepted kinds); LOADING-FRAME-CONNECTSHARE is a real but invisible structural difference and waits for the answer to ConnectShare Q4.

rules.reason: The capture renames a link's href to data-original-href, so the replayed reference home link of NavigationLanding and its icon have cursor auto; the app's link has its href (cursor pointer). Same artifact as CAPTURE-LINK-HREF-CURSOR-MENUICON-BACK; auto-accepted in the user's auto mode 2026-10-15

The status message (the Get_ShareDetails exception message) is masked by the capture as 54 bullets; the centred title box takes the text's width, so its x offset follows the text (reference 52 px with bullets, clone 77 px with the fictional mock message, Q1). y and every other box match; auto-accepted in the user's auto mode 2026-10-15

PENDING ConnectShare Q4. The original creates the screen view only after OnInitialize ends (OutSystems.js:2, fireInitialize awaited), and in the loading capture Get_ShareDetails never answers, so #reactContainer stays empty; the clone's AppFrame always renders #transitionContainer and the screen renders nothing inside it until OnInitialize ends. Nothing visible differs (pixels 0.00%).

callOrderFree.reason: On TST the screen's OnInitialize sent Get_ShareDetails together with the app start's SynchAppContext (both at 2824 ms), before AfterInitialize; in the clone the screen mounts after the shell's app start sent SynchAppContext and AfterInitialize. Its place among the app-start calls depends on timing; counts are still compared; auto-accepted in the user's auto mode 2026-10-15
